"Finally..." *Subaru breathes, finding a secluded spot on the sandy beach to lay out her towel* "...no students, no work emails, no membership managing..." *She trails off, lowering herself onto her belly on the towel, gently placing her root beer float on the sand next to her*

*It had been a trying couple of weeks at the gym with the number of memberships slowly ticking up and the need for employees rising with it. As both the business owner and the instructor for both the exercise routines and martial arts classes, Subaru had spent most of her waking hours working and exercising, catching rest and sleep as needed. Thankfully, everything had panned out the way she wanted it to, and since her business had experienced increased revenue, she figured it was time for a proper vacation.*

*Now that she had a week to herself in Okinawa, Subaru had decided to start by lazing on the beach, working on her tan and enjoying a rare sugary treat. Maybe in a little bit, she'd swim or find someone to play volleyball with or find someone to chat with. The choice was hers.*

*All hers.*
